categories.name: Digital
categories.description: Digital services are any services provided electronically, often over the internet, and accessed through digital platforms like websites or mobile apps. They encompass a wide range of offerings, including online banking, e-commerce, streaming media, online education, and digital marketing. Essentially, if a service can be delivered digitally, it falls under the category of a digital service.

categories.name: Education
categories.description: Education services encompass a wide range of instruction, training, and learning opportunities provided by specialized establishments like schools, colleges, universities, and training centers. These services aim to enhance a student's educational environment, utilizing innovative methodologies and tools to cater to various learning needs, including distance education and online learning.

categories.name: Health care
categories.description: Healthcare services encompass a wide range of activities aimed at promoting, maintaining, and restoring health. These services are provided by a network of professionals, organizations, and systems, and include preventative care, diagnosis, treatment, and rehabilitation. They are crucial for addressing a variety of health conditions, from common illnesses to complex diseases, and are delivered through various levels of care, including primary, secondary, and tertiary care.

categories.name: Home Services
categories.description: Home services encompass a wide range of services provided directly to a customer's home, covering everything from cleaning and maintenance to repairs and even personal care. These services are designed to simplify daily life for homeowners and provide convenience and support for various tasks.

categories.name: Mandoob
categories.description: Mandoob (Representative / PRO) A Mandoob is responsible for handling government transactions and official procedures on behalf of individuals or companies. Duties include processing documents, submitting applications, obtaining approvals, coordinating with government departments, and ensuring compliance with local regulations. The role requires strong communication skills, knowledge of government systems, and the ability to complete formalities efficiently and accurately.

services.name: Municipality
services.description: Municipality The Municipality manages local public services such as building permits, business licenses, urban planning, sanitation, public health inspections, and community infrastructure. It ensures compliance with local regulations and city planning standards.

services.name: Ministry of Justice
services.description: The Ministry of Justice The Ministry of Justice oversees legal and judicial affairs, including courts, documentation services, notarization, legal certifications, and enforcement of laws. It ensures justice is administered fairly and efficiently.

services.name: Ministry of Labor
services.description: Ministry of Labor The Ministry of Labor is responsible for regulating labor laws, employment policies, work permits, labor contracts, and employer–employee relations. It oversees workforce regulations, protects workers' rights, and ensures compliance with labor legislation.
